sources.title: City of Sammamish — Residential Remodel Submittal Checklist (2026-01-RMDL)
sources.supports: MBP path Building / Single-Family Residential / Remodel; required items: Acceptance of Financial Responsibility, Historic Resources Affidavit, legal description, plan set as-is and proposed, project narrative, Residential Fixture Count Form; potentially sewer/water certificates when adding fixtures or exceeding 50% assessed value; Sammamish Plateau Water or Northeast Sammamish Water & Sewer District; PermitTech@Sammamish.us; address 801 228th Ave SE.

sources.title: City of Sammamish — Building Permit Application
sources.supports: Submit via MyBuildingPermit.com; for single-family alterations a separate Electrical Permit is required when electrical work occurs; mechanical and plumbing can be included with fixture count; Owner-as-Builder affidavit path.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit.com
sources.supports: Regional online permitting portal used by Sammamish.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit Tip Sheet 00 — Permits Required / Not Required (June 11, 2026)
sources.supports: Sammamish listed with electrical circuits/services required by City; bathroom and kitchen fixture replacements without plumbing line modifications typically not requiring building permit; tub and shower replacement does require a permit; critical/shoreline/sensitive area caveat.
